hardware.candidate_scoring: one forward; three restricted next-token logits

allocator_limit.scope: PyTorch CUDA allocator only; host RAM and external allocations are outside this quota

evaluation.latency_note: CPU encoder, transfer, projection and LLM scoring only; excludes array/resampling/tokenization/harness. Status/acquisition work may run concurrently; no other GPU compute was admitted.

eeg_shuffled.evidence_scope: Consistency of logged source IDs and original recording times; not an independent rerun of model inputs.

eeg_time_shifted.evidence_scope: Actual raw extraction certificates were independently decoded and compared; original inputs were matched to checkpoint-sealed bytes. This is not prospective causal preprocessing.

context_only.class_averaging: macro_f1 includes all declared classes (zero when unsupported); balanced_accuracy averages recalls of present classes; missing classes block goal validation
context_only.abstention_policy: Abstentions count as false negatives in balanced_accuracy and macro_f1; forced_accuracy ignores abstention.

measurement.measurement_method: actual frozen five-condition inference; PyTorch CUDA allocator peaks and CPU getrusage RSS high-water
measurement.latency_scope: CPU EEG encoder, transfer, projection and one LLM forward; excludes array I/O, resampling, tokenization and harness

allocator_limit.scope: PyTorch CUDA allocator only; host RAM and external allocations are outside this quota

measurement.concurrent_workload: Read-only status/metadata and background acquisition may be active; no other GPU compute process was admitted. This is not an isolated end-to-end latency benchmark.
measurement.memory_scope: CUDA peak is accelerator allocator use; CPU EEG encoder/RSS is a distinct host scope
measurement.memory_measurement_scope: CUDA peak is accelerator allocator use; CPU EEG encoder/RSS is a distinct host scope

resource_feasibility.limits_are: project configuration; not research-established universal thresholds
resource_feasibility.scope: Reported measured configuration only; accelerator and host memory scopes must not be conflated, and component latency is not end-to-end task latency.

preprocessing_causality.interpretation: Metadata availability contract; successful retrospective classification alone does not establish prospective causal preprocessing.
